content_sections.heading: About CRCSRE Guwahati
content_sections.text: CRCSRE Guwahati is the Composite Regional Centre for Skill Development, Rehabilitation & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, located in Guwahati, Assam. The centre runs a BASLP course, and these Guest Faculty positions are for teaching in that course. The notice is signed by the Director, CRCSRE-Guwahati.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: CRCSRE Guwahati has advertised 4 Guest Faculty positions in total, one in each subject area. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints one qualification line covering all four positions. Experience requirements are not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: Guest Faculty – Lecturer – Audiology; Guest Faculty – Lecturer – Speech-Language Pathology; Guest Faculty – Linguistics (45 hours); Guest Faculty – Statistics (18 hours)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The positions are an engagement of Guest Faculty for the BASLP course at the centre. The Linguistics position is for 45 hours and the Statistics position is for 18 hours. The notice does not mention the hours for the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology lecturer positions, and the honorarium or pay is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRCSRE Guwahati Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for CRCSRE Guwahati Guest Faculty are sent by email only. The notice gives these instructions: Prepare your updated Bio-data/CV. Add your relevant educational and professional qualification details to the Bio-data/CV. Email the Bio-data/CV to [email protected] . Send it on or before 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CRCSRE Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 Guest Faculty positions, one each in Audiology, Speech-Language Pathology, Linguistics (45 hours) and Statistics (18 hours).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CRCSRE Guwahati Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The Bio-data/CV must be emailed on or before 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for CRCSRE Guwahati Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The qualification for all four positions is as per RCI Norms.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for CRCSRE Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email your updated Bio-data/CV with relevant educational and professional qualification details to [email protected] on or before 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. For which course are the Guest Faculty being engaged?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty are being engaged for the BASLP course running at CRCSRE Guwahati.

faq.question: Q6. How many hours are the Linguistics and Statistics positions for?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty – Linguistics position is for 45 hours and the Guest Faculty – Statistics position is for 18 hours.

faq.question: Q7. Do I need to apply again if I have already applied?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that those who have already applied or submitted will be considered.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for CRCSRE Guwahati Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The positions are at CRCSRE in Guwahati, for the BASLP course run at the centre.
